summary: Pair 01 (L1 2D Shape Hunt + WS1) clears the bar on all six categories at level 4. Duration 35 min (7/20/8) fits K. Sammy refrain chanted 3x with claps in both minds_on and consolidation. Expanded_walkthrough cites van Hiele 1986, Clements & Sarama 2009 prototype-effect, and Clements/Wilson/Sarama 2004. Recovery_moves are diagnostic-branched A/B/C. for_movement_learners offers an explicit NO-PAPER, NO-PURCHASE PATH. Worksheet Parts 1-3 mirror the lesson with a transfer task in Part 2 (oval, pentagon, semicircle).
